title: Piplup — A Very Proud Little Wave
description: A freestanding Piplup with a broad softly curved crown, rounded white cheeks, bright eyes, a tapered waving flipper, a navy cape and three tail feathers. The rounded shell is tied through a compact internal spine to two broad yellow feet.

sections.name: Rounded body and fitted navy cape
Tapered waving flipper and resting flipper
Round head with a continuous curved crown
White cheeks and curved blue forehead
